theme: hybrid (strict monochrome default + Apple-style cinematic dark for demo section)

typography.headings: Inter or SF Pro Display, tight tracking (tracking-tighter), high contrast weights (Light vs Black).
typography.body: Clean Sans-serif, leading-relaxed, text-slate-400 in dark sections.
typography.callouts: Uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs, font-bold for external explanation labels.

colors.global: Strict Monochrome (Black, White, Gray scale). No gradients.
colors.demo_section: Deep Obsidian (#000000) background to make the laptop screen pop. Crystal Glassmorphism for floating callouts (bg-white/10, backdrop-blur-xl, border-white/20).
colors.posters: Vibrant abstract photography backgrounds with strict dark overlays (bg-black/50) to maintain monochrome typography readability.

visual_enhancers.laptop_frame: High-res MacBook bezel overlay (SVG or high quality PNG). Content (Ahi iframe) goes strictly inside the screen area with rounded-sm overflow-hidden.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used exclusively for the floating explanation cards around the laptop to emulate Apple's sleek interface overlays.
visual_enhancers.lighting: Simulated screen glow reflecting on the background using a subtle, blurred radial gradient behind the laptop.

IndustryPoster.description: Branded poster cards designed to be used as OpenGraph/meta images for Slack and email unfurls. Features abstract imagery, bold typography, and industry-specific accents.

MacBookDemoHero.description: Scroll-linked cinematic section. Contains a sticky container. As user scrolls, the MacBook scales up/opens, and floating explanation cards fade in around it.

FloatingCallout.description: Framer Motion animated card connected to the laptop frame. Explains Ontology, routing, agent execution, etc. Uses crystal glassmorphism.

layouts.demo_section: Absolute positioned layers within a sticky relative container. Parent height: 300vh-400vh for generous scroll distance. Sticky child height: 100vh. Center aligned laptop to act as the focal hero.
layouts.callouts: Arranged asymmetrically around the laptop frame using absolute positioning (e.g., top-1/4 left-10, bottom-1/3 right-10).

patterns: Scroll-linked scaling: useScroll + useTransform to scale the laptop from 60% (and translated Y) to 100% as the user scrolls down.
Staggered callouts: as the laptop reaches 100% scale, use scroll progress thresholds to fade and slide in the external explanation cards (Ontology, Agent Execution, Approval, Audit).
Reduced motion: Check useReducedMotion() from framer-motion to fallback to simple opacity fades instead of heavy scaling.

accessibility.aria: Add aria-hidden='true' to the laptop bezel and decorative SVG lines.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure floating callout text is readable against the dark background. Use APCA contrast guidelines.

image_urls.description: Abstract glowing blue lines forming a wave pattern

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT touch or refactor anything outside the real use-cases demo section. Maintain the strict monochrome language globally.
In the demo section, implement an Apple-inspired scroll-linked animation using Framer Motion.
Create a sticky container (e.g., `h-[400vh]`) with a `sticky top-0 h-screen overflow-hidden` inner div.
Place the existing Ahi iframe workspace inside a MacBook frame graphic. If using CSS, create a realistic bezel with inner shadows.
Use `useScroll` and `useTransform` to animate the MacBook. Start closed or scaled down, and scale up to full view as the user scrolls.

Around the laptop, render absolutely positioned `FloatingCallout` components that explain 'Ontology', 'Routing', 'Agent Execution', 'Approval', and 'Audit'. Animate their opacity and Y-position based on the same scroll progress.

For the decision-map links, build an `IndustryPoster` component that acts as the visual thumbnail/OpenGraph preview. Inject the selected abstract Unsplash images as backgrounds with a dark overlay and bold monochrome typography.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for the cinematic callouts.
Avoid generic centered layouts except for the focal MacBook hero.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with hover transitions.
